$comment: 版本策略，不是固定版本清单。生成新工程时核实官方最新稳定版本和兼容矩阵，再把解析结果写入生成项目的 gradle/libs.versions.toml。

sources: Android Developers release notes and compatibility tables
Kotlin and Gradle official release information
version_policy.if_sources_unavailable: Do not guess or claim latest-compatible. Keep prototype planning available, but stop before rendering a new build configuration until current official versions can be verified.

compatibility_rules: Resolve a compatible set, not the newest version of each artifact independently.
Use only stable releases unless the user explicitly requests a prerelease or a required capability is only available there.
Resolve KSP and compiler plugins using their official compatibility rules for the selected Kotlin version.
Use Compose BOM for BOM-managed Compose artifacts and do not assign those artifacts separate versions.
Keep the resolved project catalog reproducible; do not use '+' or latest.release selectors in the generated project.
When modifying an existing project, preserve its current catalog and wrapper unless the user requests an upgrade.

module_policy.version_catalog: The root gradle/libs.versions.toml is the source of plugin and dependency versions.
module_policy.build_logic: Included build convention plugins may import the root catalog; do not maintain a second drifting version catalog.
module_policy.module_build_scripts: Use catalog aliases and convention plugins; do not hardcode dependency versions.
